subject: general
question: The ability of a computer to perform millions of tasks or calculations with the same _______ and accuracy is called its diligence.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Consistency.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Consistency** refers to the ability of a computer to perform tasks or calculations with the same level of accuracy and reliability repeatedly.
 
• The diligence of a computer is characterized by its consistency in delivering results without fatigue, errors, or distractions.
 
• Unlike humans, computers do not get tired or bored and can maintain their performance over extended periods.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Speed:** Computers are known for their speed, but it does not directly define their diligence. Speed refers to how quickly a computer can perform tasks.
 
• **Willingness:** This is not a relevant characteristic of computers, as they do not have emotions or desires.
 
• **Capacity:** While capacity refers to the amount of data a computer can handle, it is not related to diligence or consistency.
